subject: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan

Taylor —

Thanks for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m sending a proposed execution plan for the Order Form commercial pieces so procurement and finance can align on invoicing and minimum commit handling. Key asks below: 

- Confirm invoice recipient entity for EU VAT (we think Orbital AI Ltd, GB/EU VAT ID needed).
- Confirm net terms target (we documented Net 45 in pricing; please confirm Net 45 vs Net 60).
- PO number and preferred PO upload method (PDF reply / procurement portal).
- Acceptance of the holdback schedule: 10% holdback for 90 days after go-live for usage credits.

Attached: OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (commercial redlines), Tax_Form_EU.pdf (tax evidence template). Kimberly and Karthik are looped for legal and finance input.

If possible, please return a PO + VAT cert by COB next Wednesday and we’ll schedule signature and an invoice cutover window for the first pro-rated invoice.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0118

Attachment stubs: OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (annotated), Tax_Form_EU.pdf (blank template)

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@orbitalai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitalai.com
Date: 2026-10-18T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan

Alex —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We can confirm the billing entity as Orbital AI Ltd (EU entity) but will need Redwood to invoice that legal entity and include our VAT number on each invoice.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 60 for new vendor pilots; can Redwood accept Net 60? If not, what flexibility exists (Net 45 with early-pay discount)?
- PO: attaching PO_12345.pdf in reply (formal PO).
- Holdback: procurement is open to a short holdback but asks that credits be applied within 30 days of release rather than waiting for accounting cycles.

Also, can you confirm whether the first invoice will be pro-rated for a mid-month activation and whether we can have invoice line-level detail for model usage by region?

—Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Head of Procurement, Orbital AI
taylor@orbitalai.com

Attachment stub: PO_12345.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan

Alex / Karthik —

Legal reviewed the commercial redlines (see OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf). Summary of material items we redlined and next steps: 

1) Invoicing recipient: MSA currently names Redwood Inc. as invoice recipient. We redlined an Order Form amendment to explicitly name Orbital AI Ltd for EU invoices and added an invoicing appendix mapping entity -> currency -> tax jurisdiction. Finance will need the VAT cert.

2) Net terms: we can accept Net 60 for this pilot provided the customer accepts a 2% early-pay discount for Net 45; redline included language for both options and a fallback to Net 45 in case of missed PO/credit checks. Please surface procurement preference.

3) Holdback / credits: legal preserved Redwood’s right to net credits against subsequent invoices and limited vendor liability for usage reconciliation; recommended operational SLA: credits are to be applied within 30 days of agreed release (matches procurement ask).

4) Tax indemnity / gross-up: redline narrows the indemnity language — customer remains responsible for withholding taxes with gross-up if required by law. Tax team provided Tax_Form_EU.pdf for onboarding.

5) Signature flow: propose DocuSign for Order Form + one-off MSA amendment (single envelope). I added a comment in the Drive link for final acceptance.

If finance confirms invoice routing and PO acceptance, legal can finalize redlines by EOD Monday and we can send for signature.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf, Tax_Form_EU.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan

Taylor —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the PO. Proposed execution steps based on the threads below: 

1) We accept invoicing to Orbital AI Ltd for EU activity. Please attach your VAT certificate (scan OK) — we’ll map the EU VAT ID to the invoice appendix.

2) Net terms options — we’re flexible: Net 60 for pilot OR Net 45 with 2% early-pay discount. If procurement prefers Net 60, we’ll route to finance for Net 60 setup and note the early-pay discount as optional. Please confirm choice.

3) First invoice: pro-rated for activation date, with line-level usage (model, region, tokens). We’ll include CSV attachment with line detail and provide a short-runbook for reconciliation.

4) Holdback: agree to 10% holdback, release after 90 days but ledger credits to be applied within 30 days after release — Redwood finance to post credit memo.

5) Signature & cutover: we’ll prepare a single DocuSign envelope containing Order Form v3 + MSA amendment. Proposed signature window: sign by 2026-10-25, first invoice on 2026-11-01 for the pro-rated period. DocuSign link: https://redwood.example.com/docusign/ORB-2026-057

Next steps for you: confirm Net 60 vs Net 45+2% early-pay, upload VAT cert if not already included in the PO, and confirm acceptance on the holdback release mechanics. Once we have those we’ll route envelope for signature and schedule the invoicing cutover with finance.

Thanks —
Alex
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment notes: We’ll send a CSV usage template and the final redline PDF in the signature envelope.

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@orbitalai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitalai.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan

Alex —

Confirming: Orbital AI accepts Net 60 for the pilot (no early-pay discount needed). VAT certificate is attached in this reply (see PO_12345.pdf includes VAT page). We accept the pro-rated first invoice and the line-level usage detail — that’s essential for our internal chargebacks.

Holdback: procurement accepts 10% holdback with credits to be posted within 30 days of release. Please flag any exceptions before DocuSign.

We’re good to proceed with signature window as proposed. Please send the DocuSign envelope and we’ll route to our legal / finance for signature.

Best,
Taylor
Head of Procurement, Orbital AI

Attachment stub: PO_12345.pdf (includes VAT cert)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form settlement flow, invoice cutover & min-commit execution plan

Alex / Kimberly —

Finance has reviewed the PO and VAT page in PO_12345.pdf and confirmed routing to our EU ledger. We’ll create the first invoice pro-rated for 2026-11-01 with line-level CSV attached. Action items for finance/legal: 

- Kimberly to finalize redline text for the invoicing appendix mapping.
- Alex to confirm DocuSign envelope contents and send the envelope.
- Finance to schedule a short handoff call with Orbital finance the day we cut invoices to verify CSV format.

I’ll block 30 minutes with Orbital finance for 2026-11-02 09:00 CET; Alex, Kimberly — can you both make that?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
